segments.he: וְאִם נָטַל כְּשֵׁרָה. לְמַאן דְּאָמַר מִפְּנֵי שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ הֶיתֵּר אֲכִילָה — הֲרֵי יֵשׁ בָּהּ הֶיתֵּר אֲכִילָה, לְמַאן דְּאָמַר לְפִי שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ דִּין מָמוֹן — הֲרֵי יֵשׁ בָּהּ דִּין מָמוֹן.
segments.en: The mishna continues: «And if he took» an etrog of teruma, «it is fit,» and he fulfilled his obligation after the fact. The Gemara explains: «According to the one who said» that one does not fulfill his obligation «because there is no permission to eat» the etrog, «there is permission to eat it. According to the one who said» that one does not fulfill his obligation «because it has no monetary» value, «it has monetary» value.
